name: End Transaction ( {error}  )
purpose: Closes a transaction. Subtracts one from the nesting counter and, when still nested, returns the stored result. At the outermost level it saves the log, commits the transaction record, and on any error reverts everything, stores the error and log, force-commits and returns the result. Returns to the original layout.
